title: Gold Jumps With Silver as Markets Track Push to Reopen Hormuz

title: Disney's Third-Quarter Profit Growth Driven by Parks, Streaming

title: Glencore Takes Provision on Exposure to Trader Radiant World

title: US Copper Trades Near Record on Tariff Risks, Hormuz Speculation

title: US Signals Steady Debt Sales to 2027, Offers ‘Subtle Change’

title: US Companies Added Fewer Jobs Than Expected in July: ADP
